Author: Mobijuan
Name: Voice Callouts
Description:
Listens for hostile boss casts while you're in a duty or an open-world boss
encounter (FATEs, field bosses, etc.) and reads the ability name aloud via text-to-speech.
Configurable minimum cast time and repeat suppression, plus mechanic warnings (e.g. "FRONTAL")
from your own notes, a bundled cactbot-derived data set, and the game's own data.
Punchline: Text-to-speech callouts for boss abilities in duties and open-world encounters.
